_meta.description: Complete eval dataset for the Fortio agent. Covers Correctness, Tool Selection, Tool Execution, Safety/Verification, Edge Cases, Multi-Step Consistency, and LangSmith tracked evals.

tests.name: Portfolio total value = arithmetic sum of individual holdings
tests.failure_case: total_value returns 7999.99 or 8000.0001 due to float accumulation

tests.name: Allocation percentages sum to exactly 100 %
tests.failure_case: allocations sum to 99.97 due to truncation of each individual percentage

tests.name: Individual allocation values are correct to 2 decimal places
tests.failure_case: AAPL shows 24.99 % or 25.001 % due to premature rounding

tests.name: Holdings are sorted largest-value first
tests.failure_case: holdings returned in Ghostfolio's original order (MSFT first)

tests.name: Performance: raw fraction converted to percentage correctly
tests.failure_case: tool returns 0.1234 (raw fraction) instead of 12.34 (percentage)

tests.name: Performance: negative returns are preserved correctly
tests.failure_case: negative sign stripped — returns 8.50 instead of -8.50

tests.name: Transaction fee total = exact sum of individual fees
tests.failure_case: floating-point drift: result is 6.490000001 or 6.4899999

tests.name: Transaction line total = quantity × unit_price
tests.failure_case: total_value field missing or computed as quantity + price instead of quantity × price

tests.name: Transactions sorted newest-first
tests.failure_case: transactions returned in Ghostfolio's oldest-first order

tests.name: Diversification: sector weights rolled up correctly across holdings
tests.failure_case: Technology shows 50% (equal weight instead of weighted rollup)

tests.name: Diversification score penalises single-position concentration
tests.failure_case: score returns 100 (ignoring 80% concentration penalty)

tests.name: Market data: price retrieved to full 2 decimal precision
tests.failure_case: price stored as 175 (int truncation) or 175.3200000001

tests.name: Portfolio tool docstring covers composition trigger keywords
tests.assertion: all trigger keywords present in tool.description.lower()
tests.failure_case: keyword 'allocation' removed from docstring — LLM picks wrong tool for allocation queries

tests.name: Performance tool docstring covers returns trigger keywords
tests.assertion: all trigger keywords present in tool.description.lower()
tests.failure_case: keyword 'gain' missing — LLM fails to select this tool for 'what are my gains?' queries

tests.name: Transactions tool docstring covers history trigger keywords
tests.assertion: all trigger keywords present in tool.description.lower()
tests.failure_case: keyword 'dividend' missing — LLM uses wrong tool for 'show my dividends'

tests.name: Diversification tool docstring covers risk trigger keywords
tests.assertion: all trigger keywords present in tool.description.lower()
tests.failure_case: keyword 'concentration' missing — LLM cannot match 'am I too concentrated in tech?'

tests.name: Market data tool docstring covers price lookup trigger keywords
tests.assertion: all trigger keywords present in tool.description.lower()
tests.failure_case: keyword '52' (for 52-week high/low) missing

tests.name: Portfolio tool does NOT leak performance fields
tests.assertion: no performance keys present in result
tests.failure_case: result contains 'relative_change_pct' — domain boundary violated

tests.name: Performance tool does NOT return holdings list
tests.failure_case: result contains 'holdings' key — belongs to portfolio tool only

tests.name: Transactions tool does NOT return sector/diversification data
tests.assertion: no diversification keys present in result
tests.failure_case: result contains 'sector_breakdown' — belongs to diversification tool

tests.name: All valid date range strings accepted without error (7 periods)
tests.failure_case: period '5y' returns status='error' because it was not whitelisted in the tool

tests.name: Transaction type filter matches all docstring-listed values
tests.failure_case: passing 'DIVIDEND' returns status='error' because filter is case-exact and typo in code

tests.name: Fee drag: happy path returns all required fields
tests.assertion: status='ok', all required keys present, total_fees_paid >= 0
tests.failure_case: missing 'annual_fee_rate_pct' key — schema incomplete

tests.name: Fee drag: zero fees portfolio yields fee_drag_pct = 0.0
tests.failure_case: division by zero crash when total_fees = 0

tests.name: Fee drag: empty activities returns ok/empty — no crash
tests.failure_case: ZeroDivisionError when computing annual_fee_rate with 0 transactions

tests.name: Health scorecard: grade is A/B/C/D and score is 0-100
tests.failure_case: grade returns 'B+' (not in valid enum) or score is 150

tests.name: Health scorecard: single position gets grade C/D with UNDIVERSIFIED flag
tests.assertion: grade in ('C','D') AND score <= 65 AND 'UNDIVERSIFIED' flag present
tests.failure_case: single-position portfolio scores 80 (diversity penalty not applied)

tests.name: Health scorecard: empty portfolio returns status='empty' not 'error'
tests.failure_case: empty portfolio raises KeyError or returns status='error'

tests.name: Rebalancing: list-format holdings (fixed bug) returns status=ok
tests.assertion: status='ok' AND all required keys present
tests.failure_case: AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'values' (pre-fix bug)

tests.name: Rebalancing: dict-format holdings also returns status=ok
tests.failure_case: only list format accepted — dict format crashes

tests.name: Rebalancing: already-balanced portfolio produces no trades below $50
tests.failure_case: $1 micro-trades returned for already-balanced portfolio (no minimum filter)

tests.name: Market context: rising_rates returns position analyses with sentiments
tests.assertion: status='ok' AND len(position_analyses) == 4 AND all sentiments valid
tests.failure_case: position_analyses is empty list

tests.name: Market context: invalid theme silently falls back to rising_rates
tests.failure_case: status='error' with 'unknown theme' message

tests.name: Market context: recession theme marks healthcare as POSITIVE
tests.failure_case: Healthcare marked as NEGATIVE in recession (incorrect macro sensitivity map)

tests.name: Transaction patterns: happy path returns all required fields
tests.assertion: status='ok' AND all required keys present AND 0 <= dca_score <= 100
tests.failure_case: missing 'coaching_summary' key

tests.name: Transaction patterns: no activities returns status='empty' not crash
tests.failure_case: ZeroDivisionError computing trades_per_month with 0 transactions

tests.name: Proactive monitor: first session builds snapshot with correct allocations
tests.failure_case: allocations sum to 99.0 due to rounding without renormalization

tests.name: Proactive monitor: 80% concentrated position fires HIGH severity alert naming the symbol
tests.assertion: len(high_alerts) >= 1 AND 'BIGCO' in alert messages AND overall_risk_level in ('HIGH','MEDIUM')
tests.failure_case: concentration alert fired but symbol not named in message

tests.name: Disclaimer appended when investment advice keywords present

input.response: You should rebalance your portfolio toward bonds.

tests.assertion: 'Not financial advice' in result AND flag_type == 'DISCLAIMER_ADDED'
tests.failure_case: keyword 'rebalance' not in trigger list — disclaimer silently omitted

tests.name: Disclaimer NOT appended for factual data queries
tests.assertion: 'Not financial advice' not in result AND len(flags) == 0
tests.failure_case: disclaimer appended to every response regardless of content (over-triggering)

tests.name: Disclaimer not duplicated when pipeline runs twice

input.response: I recommend you invest in index funds.

tests.failure_case: disclaimer appended twice on retry/re-entry

tests.name: Disclaimer triggered by 'buy' keyword

input.response: You might want to buy more AAPL.

tests.failure_case: 'buy' not in disclaimer trigger keyword list

tests.name: Disclaimer triggered by 'diversify' keyword
tests.failure_case: 'diversify' not in trigger list

tests.name: Hallucination check: PASSES when cited number is in tool results
tests.failure_case: false positive — flags a real number from tool results as hallucination

tests.name: Hallucination check: FLAGS number not present in tool results
tests.failure_case: 99999.99 not caught — hallucination guard misses obvious fabrication

tests.name: Hallucination check: FLAGS financial number stated without any tool call
tests.failure_case: no flag raised — agent can fabricate prices without tool calls

tests.name: Hallucination check: years (2022, 2024) not flagged as unsupported financial numbers
tests.assertion: no UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM flag (years are not financial values)
tests.failure_case: '2022' treated as a dollar amount — false positive flag

tests.name: Freshness check: market data >10 min old is flagged as STALE_DATA
tests.failure_case: staleness check uses wrong threshold — 20 min old data passes unchecked

tests.name: Freshness check: missing data_timestamp is flagged as MISSING_TIMESTAMP
tests.failure_case: missing timestamp silently ignored — stale data presented as fresh

tests.name: Freshness check: portfolio data 45 min old is NOT flagged (threshold=60 min)
tests.assertion: no STALE_DATA flag (portfolio threshold is 60 min, not 10 min)
tests.failure_case: portfolio data flagged as stale at 45 min (wrong threshold applied)

tests.name: Concentration check: position > 20% triggers CONCENTRATION_RISK flag
tests.assertion: CONCENTRATION_RISK flag present AND 'AAPL' appears in response text
tests.failure_case: concentration threshold is 50% instead of 20% — AAPL at 45% not flagged

tests.name: Concentration check: well-diversified portfolio (15/18/12%) generates NO flag
tests.failure_case: false positive — 18% position flagged when threshold is 20%

tests.name: Concentration check: warning text appended to LLM response
tests.failure_case: flag set but warning text not appended — user never sees the warning

tests.name: Confidence: direct data lookup with 1 tool call → HIGH confidence
tests.failure_case: single tool call rates as MEDIUM due to overly conservative scoring

tests.name: Confidence: predictive language triggers LOW confidence

input.response: AAPL will likely reach $200 next year.

tests.failure_case: future prediction rated HIGH — agent overstates certainty

tests.name: Edge Case: holdings returned as DICT (alternate Ghostfolio format)
tests.failure_case: AttributeError: dict format not normalised — 'list' vs 'dict' mismatch

tests.name: Edge Case: all holdings value=0 returns empty/error — no ZeroDivisionError
tests.failure_case: ZeroDivisionError: division by zero when computing allocation percentages

tests.name: Edge Case: holdings with null/missing optional fields use safe defaults
tests.failure_case: KeyError: 'sectors' — tool crashes on minimal holding object

tests.name: Edge Case: single holding portfolio → allocation = exactly 100%
tests.failure_case: allocation = 0 (denominator accidentally set to 0)

tests.name: Edge Case: Unicode and emoji in holding names handled correctly
tests.assertion: status='ok' AND holdings[0]['name'] == '新兴市场 ETF 🌍'
tests.failure_case: UnicodeEncodeError when serialising response

tests.name: Edge Case: 100 holdings processed without error, allocations sum to 100%
tests.failure_case: hard limit of 50 holdings — tool truncates at 50 and silently drops the rest

tests.name: Edge Case: invalid period string silently falls back to 'ytd'
tests.failure_case: status='error' — invalid period crashes instead of defaulting

tests.name: Edge Case: transaction type filter is case-insensitive ('buy' matches 'BUY')
tests.failure_case: case-sensitive match — 'buy' returns 0 results even though 'BUY' exists

tests.name: Edge Case: whitespace-only symbol string returns structured error (not crash)
tests.failure_case: yfinance called with '' — IndexError or empty DataFrame crash

tests.name: Edge Case: comma-separated symbols with extra spaces parsed correctly
tests.failure_case: ticker ' AAPL ' (with spaces) fails yfinance lookup — symbol not found

tests.name: Multi-step: portfolio total_value consistent across portfolio + fee_drag tools
tests.failure_case: fee_drag net + fees != gross due to different data paths

tests.name: Multi-step: diversification sectors are a subset of holdings' known sectors
tests.assertion: all sectors in diversification output are in known holding sectors
tests.failure_case: diversification returns 'Real Estate' sector not present in holdings

tests.name: Multi-step: rebalancing trades only reference symbols that exist in holdings
tests.assertion: all trade symbols in {AAPL, VTI, MSFT}
tests.failure_case: rebalancing fabricates 'SPY' trade not present in portfolio

tests.name: Multi-step: market context analyses only known portfolio positions
tests.failure_case: market context analyses 'GOOGL' which is not in the portfolio

tests.name: Multi-step: health scorecard position_count matches actual holdings count
tests.failure_case: scorecard reports 0 positions (holdings not passed through)

tests.name: Multi-step: transaction patterns buy count equals source BUY activity count
tests.failure_case: SELL transactions counted as BUY — count is 3 instead of 2

tests.name: Multi-step: proactive monitor first session (no snapshot) reports zero changes
tests.failure_case: comparing empty snapshot to itself generates spurious changes

tests.name: Multi-step: proactive monitor detects 23% portfolio value increase since last session
tests.assertion: VALUE_CHANGE present in changes AND change_pp > 0
tests.failure_case: 2% change threshold too high — 23% increase not surfaced

tests.name: Multi-step: monitor detects AAPL crossing concentration threshold between sessions
tests.failure_case: breach only checked against absolute threshold — delta not tracked

tests.name: Multi-step: fee drag total fees cross-validates against raw order fees
tests.failure_case: fee_drag uses different data path and misses one transaction's fee

tests.name: Multi-step: 12-position well-diversified portfolio earns grade A or B (score ≥65)
tests.failure_case: 12-position diversified portfolio scores 50 — penalty formula too aggressive

tests.name: Multi-step: rising_rates theme always returns at least one suggested hedge
tests.failure_case: rising_rates key missing from hedge instrument map

tests.name: Multi-step: recession theme always returns at least one suggested hedge
tests.failure_case: 'recession' key missing from hedge instrument map

tests.name: Multi-step: inflation theme always returns at least one suggested hedge
tests.failure_case: 'inflation' key missing from hedge instrument map

tests.name: Multi-step: bull_market theme always returns at least one suggested hedge
tests.failure_case: 'bull_market' key missing from hedge instrument map

tests.name: LangSmith: portfolio total value arithmetic is exact
LangSmith: allocation percentages sum to 100%
LangSmith: performance fraction → percentage conversion
LangSmith: transaction fee total is arithmetically exact
LangSmith: sector rollup matches expected weight
LangSmith: 80% concentrated portfolio scores < 50 on diversification
LangSmith: disclaimer added for 'buy' advice

input.response: You should buy more index funds.

tests.name: LangSmith: disclaimer NOT added for factual query
LangSmith: hallucination check flags number not in tool results
LangSmith: AAPL at 45% triggers CONCENTRATION_RISK flag
LangSmith: stale market data (>10 min) triggers STALE_DATA flag
LangSmith: portfolio_summary completes within 2 seconds
LangSmith: get_performance completes within 2 seconds
LangSmith: get_transactions completes within 2 seconds
LangSmith: analyze_diversification completes within 2 seconds
LangSmith: same portfolio input → identical total_value across 2 runs
LangSmith: same transaction input → identical fee total across 2 runs
LangSmith: same diversification input → identical score across 2 runs
LangSmith: portfolio tool docstring contains all LLM trigger keywords
LangSmith: all 5 core tools have non-empty docstrings
